item.text: The loader starts from `Default()`, but currently omits the three pool keys and never maps the update flag. `Default()` currently sets that flag to true, which conflicts with the requirement that it be false when absent and that the shipped commented configs load exactly to `Default()`. I’ll make false the default, add explicit key mapping, and give each `Load` call its own Viper instance so keys from a previous config cannot leak into later loads.

The implementation and config fixture are updated, and `go test ./config` passes. The fixture now exercises all three pool settings and an explicit update-check value; the default and deprecated fixture cases continue comparing against `Default()`, including the new false default. I’m reviewing the final diff for unintended changes.

item.text:
Implemented the config loader updates in [config.go](/app/config/config.go):

- Added `MaxIdleConn`, `MaxOpenConn`, and `ConnMaxLifetime`, with mappings from the requested `db.*` keys.
- Mapped `meta.check_for_updates` and set its default to `false`.
- Gave each `Load` call a fresh Viper instance so values from earlier loads cannot carry over.

Updated the advanced config fixture and expected values. `go test ./config` and `git diff --check` passed.
